stem.text: The photomicrograph shows the ultrastructure of part of a cell.

stem.alt: Black and white micrograph showing part of a cell.

stem.text: Which statement about the type of cell shown in the photomicrograph is correct?

A.text: It is a plant cell because it has both chloroplasts and a nucleus.

B.text: It is a plant cell because it has chloroplasts.

C.text: It is an animal cell because it has a cell membrane.

D.text: It is an animal cell because it has mitochondria.
